title: Inner derivations of a Lie algebra with nondegenerate Killing form
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $L$ a finite-dimensional $k$-Lie algebra [def-wf-lie-algebra]. Suppose the Killing form $B(x,y)=\operatorname{Tr}_L(\operatorname{ad}(x)\operatorname{ad}(y))$ is nondegenerate: if $B(x,y)=0$ for all $y$ then $x=0$, where $\operatorname{ad}(x)y=[x,y]$ and trace is [def-weil-endomorphism-trace]. For every $k$-linear derivation $D:L\to L$, meaning $D([x,y])=[D(x),y]+[x,D(y)]$, there exists $z\in L$ with $D(x)=[z,x]$ for every $x\in L$. No characteristic-zero assumption is required.
